primitives.name: Dual-Phase Tactical Manifold
primitives.verbatim_quote: 136 FOOTBALL of the two half backs are practically the same, the plays are in opposite directions.
primitives.assumptions: Two half-backs operate in symmetric but opposing tactical roles; play direction is binary and deterministic within a given phase.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When both half-backs execute identical movements, leading to tactical redundancy or collision.

layer2.mapping: Tactical manifold maps to a symmetric group action on a binary vector space representing offensive vs defensive orientation.
layer2.telemetry: Directional consistency across half-backs during execution of opposing plays.

primitives.name: Kinematic Positional Constraint
primitives.verbatim_quote: The position for the half back to assume on the defensive depends on the style of game that the team is playing.
primitives.assumptions: Defensive positioning is a function of game style and requires dynamic adjustment based on opponent behavior.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure to adjust position leads to misalignment with defensive strategy or vulnerability to counterplay.

layer2.mapping: Positional constraint kernel derived from game-state vector and defensive formation matrix.
layer2.telemetry: Deviation from optimal defensive alignment relative to opponent formation.

primitives.name: Disinformation Avoidance Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: They should not, by word or by act, give away the point of attatk or the direction in which the play is going.
primitives.assumptions: Intentional misdirection is a critical component of play execution; actions must remain consistent with strategic intent.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Violation results in premature revelation of play direction, allowing opponent to react accordingly.

layer2.mapping: Protocol modeled as information-theoretic entropy minimization over action-space distribution.
layer2.telemetry: Frequency of unintentional behavioral cues indicating play direction.

primitives.name: Line Penetration Kinematics
primitives.verbatim_quote: In bucking the line, the half back should go in low and hard.
primitives.assumptions: Low trajectory maximizes momentum transfer while maintaining visibility for navigation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Excessive lowering impairs vision, increasing risk of collision with teammates or opponents.

layer2.mapping: Kinematic kernel defined by vertical angle of approach and horizontal velocity vector.
layer2.telemetry: Angle of descent and forward momentum during line-breaking maneuvers.
